name: claude-unobserved-trailing
description: e1 is observed. The LAST op `u` is an edit whose payload the hook reduced, and no later op's `before` reveals what it wrote, so the engine can never learn the real text of the lines it changed (hence stage `align`: WHY-23 has the real file). Rule 6: every line that differs between the state before and after `u` is Unknown(payloadReduced): the rewritten `q.insert` line and the new `# end` line. Lines `u` did not change keep their origin, including e1's.
